panels.scene: DANA at a kitchen table with a phone on speaker and a single blank sheet of paper in front of her, pen ready.
dialogue: Want to write down a normal day together?

panels.scene: WALT at his own kitchen table with a pen and a sheet of paper, bicycle visible through a doorway, the green kettle on the stove, amused.

DANA, curly shoulder-length hair tied back, hoop earrings, denim shirt over a t-shirt, at her kitchen table, smiling, sliding one sheet of paper into a plain folder, phone beside her, the green kettle on the counter behind her.
panels.caption: He wrote it. She kept a copy.
